sql.query:
with demo_user as (
  select id from "user" where username in ('ana', 'bruno')
),
del_path as (
  delete from user_path where user_id in (select id from demo_user) returning id
),
del_attempt as (
  delete from diagnostic_attempt where user_id in (select id from demo_user) returning id
),
del_progress as (
  delete from activity_progress where user_id in (select id from demo_user) returning id
)
select (select count(*) from del_attempt)::int as attempts,
       (select count(*) from del_path)::int as paths,
       (select count(*) from del_progress)::int as progress
